outcome: Perinatal factors associated with antenatal corticosteroid use
cohort: Preterm infants born at < 34 weeks of gestation and admitted to 18 tertiary maternal centers in China from 2017 to 2018
finding: The rate of antenatal corticosteroid exposure varied among maternity hospitals, and antenatal corticosteroid use was associated with a lower odds of bronchopulmonary dysplasia or death and invasive respiration requirement in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Antenatal corticosteroid exposure was higher among women with caesarean section delivery.
